data.name: DIMAZE
data.detailed_description:
Infinite Growth and Infinitely Scaling Difficulty
This is a high-stakes 3D action roguelike where your powers grow exponentially—as long as you stay alive. Skills found within the tower stack to create overwhelming synergy, pushing your destructive power to its absolute limits. But be warned: the tower’s difficulty scales endlessly alongside you.

One Mistake Means Death: Extreme Dodge-Based Combat
There is no such thing as "increasing your Max HP" in this world. Your character remains fragile, and a single mistake can be fatal. Survival depends entirely on your dodge skills and equipment durability. In a gritty combat system devoid of flashy effects, you must read the enemy's subtle telegraphed motions to survive.

Stain the World with "Pink History"
Every enemy defeated results in a burst of vivid "Pink Ink." These stains remain permanently on the walls and floors unless you choose to clean them. The history of your fierce struggles transforms the dungeon into a canvas of combat.

data.short_description: Conquer infinite difficulty with limitless growth in this 3D action roguelike. Stain the world with vivid pink ink through high-speed combat. One mistake resets all progress. How far can you evolve in the Tower of Severance?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements may change during development.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains combat scenes using weapons such as large scythes. Striking or defeating enemies results in splashes of stylized pink ink. It also features heavy emotional themes related to character death and memory loss.
